method: Computer Use (@oai/sky get_app_state) for the accessibility tree; window capture (692x434 = the 1710x1073 rig at 0.4047 scale) scanned row-by-row and column-by-column for colour runs and boundaries. No vision model was used (it returned HTTP 429 again).

measured.screenCaptureCrossCheck: Full-screen capture 3420x2224 device px (display 'looks like' 1710x1112), resampled to 1710 wide so 1px = 1 logical px. knownLimitation: No visual comparison was possible: the vision model answered HTTP 429 on every attempt in this session (view_image on the Cursor capture, the Caret capture, and the mockup screenshot). Every number above comes from AX text and pixel scans, never from looking at a picture. A hand-built mockup therefore stays an approximation; the only decisive parity check is the section 8 gate 2 method - measure Caret's own rendered DOM/compositor at the same viewport and compare against these Cursor values.
correctionsToSection3: There is no in-window menu bar and no title bar band: Cursor/File/Edit/View/Window/Help is the macOS menu bar (an AX sibling of the window) and the traffic lights float over the sidebar.

The right side is ONE panel (Panel editor-panel-group) headed by 'Tabs' + 'Open new tab menu' + 'Enter Full Screen' + 'Hide Apps', with Changes / Browser / Terminal / File as tab-strip entries. 'Show Apps'/'Hide Apps' toggles this panel (storage key cursor/glass.rightPane); it is about 608px wide, the same as the composer.
The empty composer has no Send button: the toolbar is 'Add agents, context, tools' / 'High' (reasoning) / 'Start voice input', above it the project popup + branch combo + 'This Mac'.

Recommendation rows carry subtitles and not every row has a Dismiss: Plan New Idea (Shift+Tab), Multitask, Run in Cloud (no subtitle), Build from a design (+Dismiss), Deploy my prototype (+Dismiss), Start with a plan, Debug an issue. 'Run in Cloud' is a cloud runtime option label (it appears in Cursor's own source inside the Autopilot PR pill), not a full cloud-agent entry point.

Sidebar order is Hide Sidebar / Go Back / Go Forward / New Chat Cmd+N / Search Cmd+K / Automations / Customize / Projects (+New Project) / Repositories (+Customize Sidebar, Open Workspace) / sortable project groups / Getting Started card (Skip step n of m, Connect Slack) / Account menu / Settings / Resize sidebar splitter. There is no 'Sessions' label and no pet button.
The installed Cursor is in dark mode, so the earlier light-only mockup did not match what the user sees; both palettes are now recorded.
